pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Neck patches exhibit larger spatial area and elongated geometry, while lower flank patches show increased fragmentation and reduced area with smoother pixel-gradient transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively constant, representing approximately 5-10% of patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, presenting as a stiff, brush-like boundary against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertically-oriented textural mark or smudge is visible on the lower mid-flank, though pixel resolution limits confirmation of underlying dermal trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian symbiont (oxpecker) on the dorsal-lateral transition of the upper shoulder.
